title: Thomason model structures in all strict higher dimensions

result.label: Thomason model structures in all strict higher dimensions
result.statement: Resolves the Ara–Maltsiniotis conjecture: for every n ≥ 1 and n = ω , small strict globular n -categories admit proper combinatorial Thomason model structures Quillen equivalent to simplicial sets. Thus strict higher categories model the homotopy theory of spaces in every stated dimension.
